visual_references.actual_view_type: Ordinary contributor photograph of Nemom station platform facade
observed_features: Low single-storey white/off-white long building with strong teal-green vertical piers and top/intermediate horizontal trim
Flat roof/parapet profile; upper small vent windows and mauve/brown rectangular doors and windows
Large independent blue shallow-pitched corrugated platform canopy in front, exposed white metal triangular/truss members; smaller darker canopy below at right
Open passage/entry through building at centre-right; red-brown slatted benches on white legs and teal low plinths
Dark red platform retaining fascia, white edge and grey concrete platform surface
uncertainties: Pre-terminal-redevelopment condition; do not invent proposed expanded terminal
Adjacent gallery photo shows former ochre trim, so current chosen dated basis must be explicit
Separate Oct2024 image shows THIRUVANANTHAPURAM SOUTH nameboard already renamed
visual_references.rights: Reference screenshot only; do not embed or redistribute source imagery as textures
